title: Royal Ballistix — Beach Siege
description: Radial ball-deflection survival for 2–10 contestants. Four physical courts: Beach Siege, wind-driven Gale Harbour, Moonwell vortex and Clockwork Keep deflectors. Silent all-bot title exhibition, 75-second four-court Tour, classic Siege and 60-second Defense Drill; saved grouped rules/style/controls/access preferences, licensed local effects, map-aware bots. Camera/CAM and public seat hooks retained. Phone/network transport is not integrated.
